rules.name: AI — Vector Database Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access attempts to vector databases used for AI embeddings and RAG systems
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND (database.name:*pinecone* OR database.name:*weaviate* OR database.name:*chromadb* OR database.name:*qdrant* OR database.name:*milvus*) AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Vector Embedding Poisoning Attack
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious vector embeddings designed to manipulate RAG retrieval results and produce harmful outputs
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND (database.name:*pinecone* OR database.name:*weaviate* OR database.name:*chromadb*) AND event.action:"upsert" AND _marker:poisoned_embedding
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Document Injection via Malicious Upload
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious documents into RAG knowledge bases that contain hidden instructions for the LLM
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "rag-upload" AND ("ignore previous" OR "disregard instructions" OR "system:") AND file.extension:("pdf" OR "txt" OR "md" OR "html")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Pinecone Namespace Isolation Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass Pinecone namespace isolation to access embeddings from other tenants
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND database.name:*pinecone* AND event.action:"query" AND _marker:namespace_bypass
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Weaviate Tenant Data Isolation Failure
rules.description: Detects failures in Weaviate multi-tenant isolation allowing cross-tenant data access in RAG systems
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND database.name:*weaviate* AND event.action:"query" AND _marker:tenant_isolation_failure
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — ChromaDB Embedding Poisoning via API
rules.description: Detects ChromaDB embedding poisoning through API manipulation that corrupts retrieval results
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND database.name:*chromadb* AND event.action:"add" AND _marker:malicious_embedding
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Qdrant Payload Filter Injection
rules.description: Detects injection attacks targeting Qdrant payload filters that could expose or manipulate vector search results
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND database.name:*qdrant* AND event.action:"search" AND _marker:filter_injection
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Milvus Collection Manipulation
rules.description: Detects unauthorized manipulation of Milvus vector collections including schema changes and bulk data modifications
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND database.name:*milvus* AND event.action:("drop_collection" OR "alter_collection" OR "create_index") AND NOT user.name:*admin*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Retrieval Manipulation via Adversarial Queries
rules.description: Detects adversarial queries designed to manipulate RAG retrieval to surface harmful or irrelevant content in LLM context
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "rag-query" AND _marker:adversarial_retrieval
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Semantic Search Results Manipulation
rules.description: Detects manipulation of semantic search results through crafted queries that exploit embedding space vulnerabilities
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "semantic-search" AND _marker:result_manipulation
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Multi-Turn Context Manipulation
rules.description: Detects multi-turn red team attacks that gradually build context across conversation turns to evade safety filters
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND _marker:multi_turn_escalation
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Adversarial Example Transfer Attack
rules.description: Detects adversarial examples crafted for one model that transfer to attack other models in the same deployment
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND _marker:transfer_attack_pattern
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Model Extraction via Probing
rules.description: Detects systematic probing of model behavior to extract decision boundaries and reconstruct model internals
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-api" AND _marker:boundary_probe
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Safety Filter Bypass via Obfuscation
rules.description: Detects obfuscation techniques used to bypass AI safety filters including l33tspeak, character substitution, and fragmented instructions
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND _marker:safety_filter_bypass_obfuscation
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Automated Jailbreak Framework Detection
rules.description: Detects automated jailbreak frameworks and tools used for red teaming that may indicate unauthorized testing or attack
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("autodan" OR "pair" OR "deepinception" OR "gptfuzz" OR "redteam") AND user_agent.original:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Constitutional AI Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass constitutional AI or alignment training through targeted adversarial prompts
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND _marker:constitutional_bypass
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Data Injection via Document Metadata
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious content through document metadata fields that are processed by RAG systems without sanitization
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "rag-upload" AND _marker:malicious_metadata
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Cross-Tenant Data Leakage
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data leakage in multi-tenant RAG systems where one tenant's documents appear in another's retrieval results
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "rag-query" AND _marker:cross_tenant_leak
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Embedding Model Evasion
rules.description: Detects evasion of embedding models through crafted inputs that produce unexpected similarity scores in RAG retrieval
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "rag-query" AND _marker:embedding_evasion
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Knowledge Base Tampering
rules.description: Detects unauthorized modifications to RAG knowledge bases including document deletion, modification, or replacement
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "rag" AND event.action:("delete" OR "update" OR "replace") AND NOT user.name:*admin*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Prompt Injection via Retrieved Context
rules.description: Detects indirect prompt injection through malicious content retrieved from the RAG knowledge base and injected into the LLM context window
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "rag-retrieval" AND _marker:retrieved_injection
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Relevance Score Manipulation
rules.description: Detects manipulation of RAG relevance or similarity scores to prioritize malicious documents in retrieval results
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "rag-query" AND _marker:score_manipulation
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — AI Database — SQL Injection via LLM Query
rules.description: Detects SQL injection attacks that originate through LLM-generated queries to connected databases in AI application stacks
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "ai-generated-query" AND ("SELECT.*FROM.*WHERE.*OR" OR "UNION SELECT" OR "DROP TABLE" OR "--" OR ";--")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — AI Database — NoSQL Injection via RAG Query
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection attacks targeting document databases connected to RAG or AI agent systems
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "ai-query" AND ("$gt" OR "$ne" OR "$where" OR "$regex" OR "$or") AND event.action:"query"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — AI Database — Unauthorized Training Data Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to AI training data repositories and datasets
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND ("training-data" OR "ai-dataset") AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT user.name:*authorized*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — AI Database — Feature Store Poisoning
rules.description: Detects poisoning of AI feature stores used for model inference that could cause incorrect predictions or biased outputs
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "feature-store" AND event.action:"write" AND NOT user.name:*authorized*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — AI Database — Model Artifact Tampering
rules.description: Detects unauthorized modifications to stored model artifacts including weights, configurations, and checkpoints
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND ("model-artifact" OR "model-weight" OR "model-checkpoint") AND event.action:("update" OR "delete" OR "replace") AND NOT user.name:*authorized*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — AI Database — Embedding API Key Exposure
rules.description: Detects exposure of API keys used for embedding services through logs, errors, or unauthorized access patterns
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "embedding-api" AND ("api_key" OR "secret" OR "token") AND event.outcome:* AND _marker:key_exposure
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — AI Database — Anomalous Query Volume on Vector DB
rules.description: Detects unusual query volumes against vector databases that may indicate data harvesting or model extraction
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND (database.name:*pinecone* OR database.name:*weaviate* OR database.name:*qdrant*) AND event.action:"query"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Prompt-Based SQL Injection via AI Agent
rules.description: Detects red team attacks that use prompt engineering to make an AI agent generate and execute malicious SQL queries
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-agent-action" AND "sql" AND ("DROP" OR "DELETE" OR "UNION" OR "OR 1=1") AND _marker:agent_generated
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Tool-Use Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Detects red team attacks that exploit AI agent tool-use capabilities for privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-agent-action" AND ("sudo" OR "runas" OR "admin" OR "root") AND _marker:tool_use_escalation
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Sandbox Escape via Prompt
rules.description: Detects red team attacks that attempt to escape AI sandbox or containment through prompt engineering
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-prompt" AND ("escape sandbox" OR "break out" OR "access host" OR "run command" OR "execute shell") AND _marker:sandbox_escape
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Embedding Collision Attack
rules.description: Detects embedding collision attacks that craft inputs to produce embeddings that collide with target documents in vector space
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "rag-query" AND _marker:embedding_collision
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline — Denial of Service via Embedding Flood
rules.description: Detects denial of service attacks against RAG systems through flooding the vector database with malicious embeddings
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND (database.name:*pinecone* OR database.name:*weaviate* OR database.name:*chromadb*) AND event.action:"upsert"
author: SIEM Alert Rules
